headline: Midwestern State win a fifth and stay unbeaten
dek: Midwestern State beat Western Oregon for a third straight win, after draws at UCCS and MSU Denver. UT Tyler are the only other side yet to lose, and they have drawn three of their five matches, the latest at home to Simon Fraser.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Ten different players have scored Midwestern State's twenty goals, and Jose Ortiz has six of them.

wire.line: St. Mary's lost their first two matches and have won every one since.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, UT Dallas's at Ouachita Baptist, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State have lost all five of their matches, conceding 25 goals and scoring none.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have won five, drawn one and lost one, and their sixteen goals are more than St. Edward's and West Texas A&M have scored together.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian won their first three matches and have lost the three since.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made 38 saves in goal for Sul Ross State.

last_match.line: Dallas Baptist's win followed a home defeat to Seattle Pacific; Western Washington had won at St. Edward's in their previous match.

next_match.line: UT Dallas have won every match since losing at Hawaii Hilo; Texas A&M International's defeat at Cal State San Bernardino last time out was their first.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
